rules.title: California Civil Code Section 1950.5
rules.requirement: A lease or rental agreement shall not contain a provision characterizing any security as 'nonrefundable.'
rules.summary_plain: Your lease cannot say that any part of your security deposit is nonrefundable.
rules.summary_plain_es: Su contrato de arrendamiento no puede decir que alguna parte de su depósito de seguridad no es reembolsable.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential leases in California.
rules.quoted_span: (n) A lease or rental agreement shall not contain a provision characterizing any security as “nonrefundable.”
